sloka: न्यवर्तत जनो राज्ञो रामम् कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् ।मनसा अपि अश्रु वेगैः च न न्यवर्तत मानुषम् ॥२-४०-४९॥
transliteration: nyavartata jano rājño rāmam kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam ।manasā api aśru vegaiḥ ca na nyavartata mānuṣam ॥2-40-49॥

translations.english: The king's men returned, with Rama circumambulated (on the plane of their minds). But from their minds they could not hold back their tears (grief).
